raw_attributes.value: FRAM Extra Guard® engine air filters are engineered to protect your engine from harmful contaminants. Replacing an air filter with FRAM Extra Guard can help improve horsepower, acceleration, and engine performance. To prevent engine wear, FRAM recommends changing your air filter every 12 months.
Ensures maximum airflow to prevent engine wear
Keep your engine running smoothly by preventing damaging particles from entering your vehicle’s engine
Protects up to 12 months or 12,000 miles (19,000 kilometers)
Installs quickly in as little as 5 minutes
Available to Order -	Part is released to customers for ordering.
